name: Cheesy Chicken Marinara Bake with Asparagus & Spinach Sauté

instructions.primary_message: Pat chicken dry with paper towels and divide between two baking dishes. Drizzle with oil and season with spices on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.36 kg chicken thighs, boneless skinless
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tsp Italian seasoning
1 ½ tsp garlic powder
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking dishes in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake until chicken is just cooked through, 15-18 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, and snap (or cut) off woody ends of the asparagus. Cut spears into 2-inch pieces and place in a medium bowl; set aside.
When the chicken is done, remove from oven. Pour marinara sauce over the chicken, then sprinkle with cheese.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ (680 g) jars marinara sauce
1 ½ cups shredded cheese, Italian blend

instructions.primary_message: Return baking dishes to the oven and continue to bake until sauce is warmed through and cheese is melted, 5-7 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add asparagus, salt, and pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until fork-tender, about 4 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
½ tsp salt
3 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: While the asparagus is cooking, wash and dry spinach (skip this step if it came pre-washed).
When the asparagus is done, add spinach to the skillet in handfuls, waiting for the spinach to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide marinara chicken bake and veggies between plates. Enjoy!
